verdict.rationale: Convex documents a built-in scheduler "for running background workflows" and lists Crons as a feature on every plan, plus workflow as a core component. Together these let a user define jobs that run autonomously in the background on the server. The evidence is only brief feature-list mentions, not detailed docs. Missing for 10: in-depth scheduler/cron documentation (scheduling semantics, retries, durability), evidence of how automations are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
